meta.title: EduKit — a platform for teachers in Kazakhstan
meta.description: An education platform: AI tools for lesson preparation, classroom games, assignments and a gradebook. In development.

landing.title: Less routine, more time for students
landing.subtitle: EduKit helps teachers in Kazakhstan prepare lessons, run classroom games, check student work and keep a gradebook in Kazakh, Russian and English.
landing.pilotNote: The platform is in development. Sign-up will open for closed pilot participants; working features will be enabled step by step.

ai.title: AI generators
ai.text: 12 categories of teaching materials: lesson plans, term plans, summative assessments, tests, presentations and more. Every result is editable.

games.title: Classroom games
games.text: 14 game templates for classes of up to 30 participants. Game results never affect grades.

assessment.title: Assignments and gradebook
assessment.text: Assignments, AI-assisted checking and a gradebook. The teacher approves every grade.

organizations.title: Schools and classes
organizations.text: Workspaces for directors, deputies, homeroom teachers, teachers and students with separated access.

landing.pricingNote: Prices are approved. The amount of AI credits in each plan will be set after measurements during the pilot. EduKit is free for students.

faq.a: The platform will first open for a closed pilot with teachers. The date will be announced separately.
No. Students use EduKit for free and have no access to paid features.
Personal data is planned to be stored in Kazakhstan. The cloud provider is still being selected; real student data is not used until the review is complete.

auth.rememberMeHint: Leave unchecked on a shared or public computer.

cabinet.title: Teacher workspace
cabinet.intro: AI tools, documents, games, assignments and the gradebook will appear here as they become ready.

sessions.title: My sign-ins
sessions.intro: Devices and browsers where you are signed in to EduKit. If you see an unfamiliar one, end it and change your password.

mfa.title: Confirm sign-in
mfa.intro: Open the authenticator app on your phone and enter the 6-digit code for EduKit.
mfa.useRecovery: No access to your phone? Enter a recovery code
mfa.useApp: Enter a code from the app

security.title: Security
security.intro: Two-step sign-in: besides your password, signing in requires a code from an app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator and others).
security.requiredNotice: Two-step sign-in is required for administrators. Set it up to continue.
security.step1: 1. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
security.manualKey: Cannot scan? Enter the key manually:
security.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
security.codesText: If you lose your phone, these codes are the only way to sign in. Each works once. We show them only now.
security.reauth: To get new codes, sign out and sign in again with a code from the app.
security.disableHint: Enter the current code from the app to turn it off.
security.adminCannotDisable: Administrators cannot turn off two-step sign-in.
security.googleIntro: Sign in with one click using your Google account. A personal Gmail works too.
security.googleNeedsPassword: To disconnect Google, set a password first: use “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
security.googleLinked: Google is connected. We sent a notice to your email.
security.googleAlreadyLinked: A Google account is already connected. Disconnect it first.
security.googleUsedElsewhere: This Google account is already linked to another EduKit user.
security.googleLinkFailed: Could not connect Google. Please try again.

admin.title: Administration
admin.intro: Platform summary, modules and the log of important actions.
admin.modulesHint: Turn a module on only after its phase is accepted. Sign-in, administration, real payments and Kundelik change only through a server command.
admin.forbidden: This section is available only to platform administrators signed in with an app code.

ksp.title: Short-term lesson plan (KSP)
ksp.intro: Fill in the lesson details — AI will draft a plan in the usual format: lesson passport and a detailed lesson flow. Do not enter students' names or personal data.
ksp.subject: Subject
ksp.notesHint: For example: “2 groups, some students with special educational needs”. No names, phone numbers or IINs.
ksp.testValues: Test credit values — not plan terms.
ksp.mock: Sample: real AI is not connected yet, the text comes from a template.

sor.title: Summative assessment (unit / term)
sor.intro: Choose a unit or a term — AI will write tasks, assessment criteria, descriptors and points. The answer key is saved separately from the student tasks. Do not enter students' names or personal data.

chat.title: AI assistant
chat.intro: Ask about lesson preparation, tasks or assessment. Answers use the curriculum when you set a subject and grade.
chat.privacy: Do not include students' names or personal data.
chat.price: A question costs {price} cr. · balance {balance} cr.

chat.contextHint: Subject and grade let the assistant search the curriculum (optional).

chat.deleteConfirm: Delete the conversation and all answers?
chat.memoryIntro: The AI takes these notes into account in every answer: subject, grades, style. Up to 20 notes.
chat.memoryPlaceholder: For example: I teach physics in grades 8–9
